text:
Ava: Quick sync — launch newsletter sequence for the new benchmark webinar. Goal: 2K signups, 25% attend, and drive 300 demo requests. draft below and want ops signoff on routing + segment sizes.

Priya: Love. What's the target audience segments?

Ava: Two primary segments: 1) Existing API users (high-usage) for Dedicated/Demo upsell, 2) Trial & free-tier signups for general edu -> webinar. Also a small high-touch list: enterprise prospects from last 90d.

Jon: Routing note — enterprise prospects should go to RevOps queue (Ben) immediately, everything else into nurture drip. Can we set an exclusion for anyone who converted in last 30 days?

Ben: Yep — CRM tag rule: if deal_stage = Closed Won OR last_activity < 30d, exclude. Also add utm_source=benchmark-webinar so we can filter. I can push automation tomorrow.

Marisol: Proposed cadence: 3 pre-launch emails (announce, what-you'll-learn, reminder), day-of reminder (2hrs), plus 3 post-webinar nudges (recording, short highlights, demo ask). For enterprise prospects, swap in an invite from AE + calendar link.

Priya: Subject line tests (A/B):
- A: "New benchmark: cut inference cost by 2x — live webinar"
- B: "How companies shave inference latency + cost — join our benchmark"
Include a low-ego variant for free-tier: "Benchmark walkthrough + practical tips — Wed"

Liam: Metrics to track per email: delivered, open, click, registration CTR (cta clicks / delivered), regs -> attend conversion, attend -> demo conversion. Add cohort for "hosted vs dedicated". Exportable by day.

Ava: Personalization tokens: company_name, plan_tier, last_api_call_date. For api users include a top-line: "Your avg latency: {{last_api_latency}}" only if we have it. Otherwise fallback copy.

Priya: Copy snippet for announce: 
"Hey {{first_name}},
We ran a cross-customer benchmark comparing Hosted vs Dedicated inference. Come see the numbers and tactical levers in our webinar — RSVP here: https://redwood.ai/benchmark-webinar — seats limited.
—Priya"

Marisol: For segmentation sizes I'm seeing ~8k eligible API users, 12k trialers, and 420 enterprise prospects. Recommend seeded send to 10% of each for the A/B before full ramp.

Jon: Routing detail: campaign-bot will tag leads with campaign_id=bench-2026 and add source=marketing/newsletter. Ben — can you confirm Pardot/GTM mapping?

Ben: Confirming. I'll map campaign_id to Pardot campaign and set lead owner = AE if enterprise_tag=true. Also add a suppression for bounced emails and low-engagement last 90d.

Ava: Timing preferences: send windows — API users: Tue/Thu 10-11am local; trialers: Wed 9am; enterprise: manual send from AE. Stagger sends over 3 days to avoid throttling.

Liam: Add tracking: campaign UTM params for each subject variant, and a hidden pixel for recording opens. Also surface job-level latency in console for the email-to-demo funnel (so Product can see load).

Priya: Creative ask: Hero image w/ 3 stat callouts + 30s GIF of live demo. Can design deliver by Mon EOD?

Ava: Yes. Ops questions: suppression list size? deliverability check?

Ben: Current suppression ~1.2k. We'll run seed deliverability using 50 internal accounts + Litmus. Also verify DKIM/SPF alignment.

campaign-bot: New campaign created: bench-2026. Preview URL: https://app.redwood.campaigns/bench-2026/preview

Marisol: Post-webinar drip copy idea: 1) recording + TL;DR, 2) short clips by topic + CTA to docs, 3) invite to 1:1 demo with prioritized calendar. Sequence over 10 days.

Ava: Action items: Priya finalize A/B copy by Fri, Ben set CRM mapping & suppression by Mon, Marisol schedule sends and seed sample by Mon, Liam set dashboards for regs->demo funnel, Jon confirm AE list and routing.

Priya: I'll drop the final copy in the channel when done.

Ben: I'll update the Pardot mapping and post the automation YAML.

Liam: I'll build the dashboards and send a preview link.

Ava: Thanks team :raised_hands:, ping here when tasks done and we'll lock send window next week.
